Elaine (Product): Quick heads-up — preview rollout for Private Compliance Toolkit: Zero‑Touch Attestation + Baseline is starting this week. :rocket:
Elaine (Product): TL;DR: automated host baseline checks (CIS-style), signed attestation artifacts for auditors, and an optional remote attestation handshake for Private/VPC/on-prem customers. No agent-side manual scripts for most customers.
Elaine (Product): Pilot is opt-in. Target: collect evidence bundles (hashes, package list, kernel config, runtime process snapshot) and produce a signed attest.tar.gz per host.
Elaine (Product): Why this matters: shortens SOC2 evidence collection from days to minutes for customers using Private and Dedicated. Also supports an offline attest mode for air-gapped installs. :shield:
Jordan - Security: Important note — remote attestation requires outbound egress to attestation.redwood.ai:443 for nonce exchange. We only send integrity hashes and metadata; no customer data or model payloads.
Matt H: Does this require a specific agent version?
Jordan - Security: Yes — agent v3.2+ (we backported attestation hooks). If you're on older agents we'll provide a one-click upgrade playbook.
Sara K: Will customers be able to download the raw evidence for audits?
Elaine (Product): Yes — auditors get an artifacts bundle signed by Redwood's attestation key and by the customer's KMS key if configured. We expose an S3-compatible signed URL for retrieval (ttl configurable).
Matt H: Telemetry/privacy question — what telemetry is involved?
Jordan - Security: Minimal. Attestation metadata + hash digests + status bits. Customers can opt out of remote attestation and use the offline evidence collector instead. All telemetry fields are documented in the preview guide.
Elaine (Product): Pilot timeline: this week — limited alpha with 5 pilot customers; next two weeks — expanded preview waves; GA target ~6 weeks after preview feedback.
Elaine (Product): How to opt in: fill the short form (internal link) or ping Jordan + DevEx. We'll schedule a quick readiness call to confirm network/KMS prerequisites.
Elaine (Product): Quick prerequisites summary:
- Private or Dedicated environment
- Agent v3.2+ installed on hosts
- (optional) KMS configured for signing (Cloud KMS or customer HSM)
- If remote attestation desired: allow outbound TLS to attest.redwood.ai:443 (mutual TLS optional)
Elaine (Product): Example offline evidence collection (run on host):
```
# on host
sudo /opt/redwood-agent/bin/collect-attest --out /tmp/attest-$(hostname).tar.gz
sha256sum /tmp/attest-$(hostname).tar.gz
```
Elaine (Product): After you upload that artifact via the customer console it will be timestamped and signed; we also provide an automated verification script.
Sara K: Can we get a short checklist for CSMs to prep customers?
Elaine (Product): Yup — CSM checklist is live in the shared drive (internal link). It covers network rules, agent upgrade steps, KMS examples, and auditor access flow.
Matt H: Any changes to pricing or billing?
Elaine (Product): Preview is free. For GA we'll offer a small per-host monthly fee or include it in Enterprise support tiers — we'll publish pricing before GA.
Jordan - Security: Action items for security team: review attestation key rotation docs, confirm HSM integration patterns, and run two internal attacker-simulations on the attestation flow.
ops-bot: scheduled: enable-preview for pilot customer acme-corp at 3223456800
Matt H: Thanks — looping in a couple ENG folks to validate agent upgrade path.
Elaine (Product): Thanks all. If you want to join the pilot or need the readiness doc, DM me or Jordan. :+1:
